purpose: The inventory of the boundaries the evidence-admission and provenance gates draw, and of the PROOF each of them carries. A boundary that no test exercises is named as such instead of being left to the reader's trust. The matrix is machine-checked: a claim of proof that names a test which does not exist, or a refusal code that the surface does not contain, fails the check.

proof_status_vocabulary.PROVEN_NEGATIVE: a negative test proves that the boundary is refused
proof_status_vocabulary.PROVEN_LIMIT: a test proves that the residual is real and is NOT eliminated
proof_status_vocabulary.PARTIALLY_NARROWED: the class is narrowed by construction and a part of it remains
proof_status_vocabulary.PROVEN_BY_LOADER: the refusal happens in the loader, before this surface can see it
proof_status_vocabulary.UNPROVEN_BY_RUNTIME: no test can be constructed in this runtime; the residual stands unmeasured
proof_status_vocabulary.UNREACHABLE_IN_CHAIN: the branch cannot be reached through the chain that calls it
proof_status_vocabulary.DEAD_BRANCH: the branch is unreachable in practice; another refusal covers the case

entries.boundary: an in-place rewrite of the same inode between the containment check and the read keeps the device and inode identity, so the mutation is not detected; the same holds for a second name that is created and removed inside the window

proved_by.test: a hardlink created and removed inside the check-to-open window is NOT detected

entries.note: The residual is bound by a test that reads the rewritten content back: the limit is measured, not asserted. A second name that still EXISTS is refused (MULTIPLE_LINKS), and that contrast is part of the same test.

entries.boundary: a concurrent writer that replaces the PARENT DIRECTORY of a target between the check and the open, and the same-name race that remains inside ONE component resolution of the rooted descriptor traversal

proved_by.test: an intermediate directory swapped to a symbolic link after the check is refused as an escape
a parent directory replaced after the check is detected

entries.note: The rooted descriptor binding narrows the class: a swap at any component is refused (ESCAPES_BASE_THROUGH_SYMLINK) and a replaced parent is detected. What remains is a same-name race inside one component resolution, which the module header states and this matrix does not claim away.

entries.boundary: a filesystem that has itself stopped responding can still block in the kernel; no user-space flag prevents a hung mount from blocking a read
entries.note: A hung filesystem cannot be constructed deterministically in this runtime. The residual is therefore UNMEASURED, not closed. O_NONBLOCK keeps a FIFO from blocking the OPEN and the regular-file guard then refuses it, but that is a different case.

entries.boundary: a bind mount inside the base is not detected: the real path of a bind-mounted file is its own path inside the base
entries.note: Creating a bind mount requires privileges that already exceed the read. The residual is UNMEASURED, not closed.

entries.boundary: the admitted material is not carried by the content commit
entries.note: The material's references must match the attestation, and the attestation is derived from files that exist. A reference that is not carried by the commit is therefore refused earlier, at the material binding. The branch stays as a defensive check.

entries.boundary: the admission artifact could not be read after the containment check succeeded
entries.note: A missing artifact is refused earlier, by the confinement check, as REF_INVALID. This branch needs a confinement failure AFTER a successful check.

entries.boundary: a corpus CONTENT file that leaves the corpus directory is refused

proved_by.test: S8 corpus content that leaves the tree is refused

entries.note: The corpus loader refuses the escaping file first, so this module's own sweep is never reached. The OUTCOME is proved; the branch is the loader's.

entries.boundary: a corpus that was REPLACED while it was being verified is refused before any attestation is produced
entries.note: The branch needs a writer that replaces the corpus directory between the re-execution and the re-anchoring. That is a race, and a race is not a test: the branch is UNMEASURED, not closed.

entries.boundary: an evaluation that cannot be re-executed at all is refused
entries.note: The re-execution of a loaded corpus does not fail for the fixture shapes this repository ships. The branch is UNMEASURED, not closed.
